t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the previous player seems to have found some patterns in relative success, but noted that the patterns varied as the game progressed, and the patterns might have been complete luck

vb_textbox.text: the person before basically told me this "some color/size combos tend to be more reliable but they change as the game goes on, and it all could be luck". my strat for most of the game was to just go right (score at first break 760, final score ~3200). i did notice part way through that the background changes, but i didnt find any correlation. the only real advice i can give is that pressing space and the s/k button at the same time and spamming it results in less "too slows".
